This graph shows the intensity of a drought for the last week of October. Indeed the given data is limited, providing a particular inability to give any conclusions. Dought is an important measurement of the ecological imprint of a particular region; however, it is important to remember that it is usually measured yearly and for multiple years, providing the ability to analyze the whole data set. Probably combining these graphs with others or a combination of them might give some interesting results, but I am not an expert in this field, thus no analogies can be made. Sharing my personal experience I live in a moderate area according to the graph and I haven't noticed any changes compared to other years they did not provide the graphs to compare so no conclusion can be made. Overall just some graph, which is must be posted under the name something, because truly it shows something, but I am not sure what.
